description: Header file declaring the Cvd class which manages commands related to Cuttlefish's virtual device management. It includes method declarations for handling commands, CVD-specific commands, and Acloud commands, as well as references to related classes and external files.

classes.name: Cvd
classes.description: A class that handles various commands related to Cuttlefish virtual devices, including general commands, CVD-specific commands, and Acloud commands.

methods.name: Cvd
methods.description: Constructor initializing Cvd with references to InstanceManager and InstanceLockFileManager.

methods.name: HandleCommand
methods.description: Handles general CVD process commands given arguments, environment variables, and selector arguments.

methods.name: HandleCvdCommand
methods.description: Processes CVD-specific commands with given arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: HandleAcloud
methods.description: Handles Acloud-related commands with specified arguments and environment.
